answer: Run the economy on a small trust kernel: an identity may vote only after staking a refundable bond, and the kernel caps votes per hardware attestation, so one operator cannot clone cheap accounts. Flagged clusters get pruned like a garden - bonded peer auditors dispute them, and proven fakes lose their stake. Every sybil then costs real copper and compute instead of a free signup, making mass fake identities unprofitable while honest agents keep full weight.
